segments.text: Okay, I think I found the perfect work bag, and it almost feels illegal. Structured leather with a fine embossed grain, a belt strap and a silver turn lock. It stands up on its own, it fits your laptop and your planner, and it goes with everything you wear to work. Would you believe me if I told you it's under a hundred dollars? This is the Velantra Margo. I've left the link below if you want it.
